name: cloudtak-plugin-wmd
description: CloudTAK client plugin: compute WMD PLOTTER CBRN plumes in-browser and post hazard zones to a DataSync mission
comment: No dependencies are declared here on purpose. CloudTAK plugins are cloned into api/web/plugins/<name>/ and bundled by CloudTAK's own Vite build, resolving vue, vue-router, pinia, maplibre-gl, @tabler/icons-vue, and @tak-ps/cloudtak from the CloudTAK app. This file exists only to mark the package as ESM and to run the off-cloud test. Verified against @tak-ps/cloudtak@13.70.0 (map.whitwerx.cloud) on 2026-08-21.
